scope: Core verified failure modes; not an exhaustive list of every runtime exception.

errors.symptom: An AI or tutorial names a built-in component that cannot be found.
check: Search BUILTIN_NODE_INDEX.json.
Check whether it is a Custom or Published component.
Check Legacy/replacement metadata.
errors.rule: Do not invent a built-in component.

errors.symptom: Two nodes cannot connect or the connection is rejected.
check: Compare source output.types with target input.accepts.
Insert a documented converter/processing component if required.
errors.rule: A type intersection is required for normal structural compatibility.

errors.symptom: A new workflow uses a component marked Legacy.
check: Read replacements on the Legacy component.
If replacement is empty, do not invent one.
errors.rule: Avoid Legacy components for new workflows.

errors.symptom: Google component cannot authenticate or operate.
check: Confirm a saved Google Connection is selected.
Confirm required scopes.
Reauthorize if refresh/authorization fails.
errors.rule: Do not paste tokens into public chat.

check: Confirm the HTTP method is one of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE and enabled for the endpoint.
errors.rule: HEAD is not documented as supported in the audited implementation.

errors.symptom: From Flow response cannot resolve a response.
check: Ensure exactly one applicable Webhook Response component is used.
errors.rule: Zero or multiple response components can produce an error.

errors.symptom: Ask AI cannot call the selected model provider.
check: Confirm provider credentials exist and validate.
Confirm the selected model is enabled.
Check timeout/provider error details.
errors.rule: Do not expose credentials while troubleshooting.

errors.symptom: Workflow JSON upload is rejected or does not load correctly.
check: Confirm the file is valid JSON.
Check component availability and legacy compatibility.
If the browser reports a non-JSON MIME type, retry with a standard JSON export.
errors.rule: Import includes legacy compatibility handling but cannot guarantee arbitrary historical formats.

errors.symptom: Updating a component may alter outputs/inputs or lose edges.
check: Review the breaking-change confirmation.
Inspect edges after the update.
Retest the workflow.
errors.rule: Do not assume all old edges can be automatically remapped.

errors.symptom: Telegram webhook registration fails or Telegram reports an error.
check: Confirm the Telegram Bot Token is present without exposing it.
Confirm the Flowi Webhook URL is public HTTPS.
Confirm any required Flowi webhook authentication is configured.
Inspect the sanitized Telegram setWebhook/getWebhookInfo result.
errors.rule: Telegram Webhook Setup is a documented Flowi extension and is separate from the per-message runtime path.

errors.symptom: Flowi Webhook receives Telegram JSON but expected parsed fields are missing.
check: Inspect the sanitized Webhook JSON first.
Confirm Webhook.JSON is connected to Telegram Update Parser.Telegram Update.
Check only the currently documented parsed fields: chat_id, user_id, username, text, command.
errors.rule: Do not invent parser fields or output types that are not published.
